name: m2-ask-light
steps: const h=window.__sim.host; const t=h.tasks.find(t=>t.title.includes('Explain the deployment')); if(!t || t.mode!=='ask' || !h.projects.find(p=>p.project_id===t.project_id).active_writer) throw Error('Ask did not coexist with writer')
